item.title: Ask your own Murph from a group
item.summary: When you explicitly ask Murph in a supported group chat to consult your own private Murph, it now follows whether you want the answer in the group or privately and asks when that is unclear.
item.details: The request stays tied to you and that group. Choosing group delivery keeps the existing advance notice; choosing private delivery does not post that notice. Existing permission and privacy checks remain, and the group never gets direct access to your private Murph or personal vault.
